A '''Toydarian''' was interviewed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] at [[Bast Castle]] on [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]] and showed a great amount of resistance to Vader's [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Mind trick/Legends|suggestions]] up to the point that Vader began to [[Torture/Legends|torture]] the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]]. Through the Toydarian, Vader learned that Toydarians could be easily intimidated by a demonstration of strength. The Toydarian eventually [[Death/Legends|died]] due to Vader's torture.
